about: Card text and thumbnails for the .rfm1 files of Quixotic7/RemoteFM1FW, by manifest id (catalog/SCHEMA.md).

amb.what: A generative ambient machine after Music for Airports: it plays itself from the start, breathing voices, bells on tape loops of unequal length, a gliding bass. You do not perform it, you tend it.
amb.author: C. Vestal

caravel.what: Felucca continued: a multi-engine synth with ANALOG, SEM, HADES, PHASE, TRIO, a tonewheel, FM6, physical models, voices, samples, grain and slices, drums, noise and an experimental DRONE engine. Pair Morph blends two engines, a HOME screen of your own and free macros a track for live sound design.
caravel.author: BonszaiMusic

choralroot.what: A Telepathic Orchid-style chord instrument: one hand plays roots, the other shapes chords; voicings, performance modes, bass and a looper.
choralroot.author: Quixotic7

clipper.tag: Deep synth grown out of SLOOP
clipper.what: A deep synth grown out of SLOOP: 23 engines and 407 sounds, from HYBRID (three oscillators, two filters, a mod matrix) to six-operator FM, wavetables, wave sequencing, a Juno and physical models; arp, step sequencer, MPE and a web editor for every parameter.
clipper.author: isod89

coralflower.what: Chords after the Orchid, with controls made for the FM-1: one key plays a chord with a bass note. Also 27 scales, an arpeggiator, a sequencer with drums and a song mode, and a pixel flower that grows as you play.
coralflower.author: FicusFicusov

duell.what: A MULTIMORPHING bitimbral synth: two complete parts, three ways to play them together, and a morph that glides between two versions of every sound. Ten engines including wavetables, twin filters, effects and a mod matrix. Layer, dual or stereo mode. Velocity sensitivity and aftertouch. Dual core.
duell.author: OSCILL/R

fartmachine.author: A. C. Wilson
fartmachine.what: A questionable musical instrument: ten artisanal farts, reverb, delay and a sixteen-step sequencer.

felucca.what: The custom firmware the others build on: the FM-1's own synth engines, a sequencer, effects and a better panel, with an editor in the browser.
felucca.author: Hügelton

fimba.what: A physically modelled kalimba: tines laid out like the real one, thumb-roll chords, mbira patterns, a sound hole to cover, grains, tape and a plate reverb. Play it in the browser first.
fimba.author: J. Sowers

fmini.what: A three-oscillator monosynth in the spirit of the classic Moogs: a 24 dB/octave ladder filter, two contours, 100 factory patches, an arpeggiator, a sequencer and MIDI. Built on Felucca.
fmini.author: ruppert

fomni.what: A chord harp inspired by the Omnichord: strum the white keys, pick chords on the black ones.
fomni.author: C. Vestal

frasil.author: Styves Goupil
frasil.what: An ambient drone instrument: tap a key to latch a drone, a note or a chord in your key. Three layers a voice into a big reverb with shimmer and freeze; GLINT's icy FM bells on top, by hand, arpeggio or sequence; BASS a deep line below, held or sequenced; three LFOs keep it all moving.

ghoulbox.what: Dungeon synth: a cathedral hall reverb, tape and crush, a hurdy-gurdy engine, choirs, organs and recorded psaltery and harp, an old-RPG screen with wall torches.
ghoulbox.author: J. Persinger

grimm.what: Dark ambient, dungeon synth and deathdream firmware: 4 tracks, 7 sound sources, real recorded choirs, tracks that play by themselves, and long tape, granular and reverb effects.
grimm.author: GRiMMBIENT

hortator.what: A drum machine: eight tracks of drums, a step sequencer, Grids, a pumping compressor, LFOs, resonators and live effects. Press PLAY to hear the power-on pattern.
hortator.author: DEADACTIVE

hyp1.author: RedtailWorks
hyp1.what: Hypnotic techno and acid: a breathing pad, a deep drone, a generative 303 line and grain over drums you sequence. Flip patterns on the bar, break it down, build it up. Forked from AMB-1. One of a pack of four: LOF-1 (a lofi groovebox), ECO-1 (a plant plays it) and GRAV-1 (a star and its planets), experimental, on its project page.

jiant.what: A bio-synthetic groovebox: six tracks drawn as living beings in thermal colours, eight engines (FM6 with Dexed, analog, phase, voice…), mutating macros, song mode from SLOOP. Not yet tested much on a real FM-1.
jiant.author: juanjiant

karma.what: A four-track groovebox: an acid bass or a Juno-style poly, physical modelling, two dozen synthesis models and a drum synth. A 64-step sequencer with song mode, generators that write parts on one chord plan, pixel characters, and USB audio with six stems, MIDI out and DAW sync.
karma.author: Ariel Muchnik

melodee.what: Total playing pleasure, far beyond Felucca: recording without quantize, microtonal scales, a Casio CZ-1, a bit-by-bit Dexed, scale modes made for an MPC Sample as its companion.
melodee.author: keremimo

minitone.what: Felucca with six tracks and new engines: SID, Braids' 48 models, a TB-303 and engines after Elektron's Analog Four, SY Chip and Digitone 2, a ping-pong delay and a new reverb. Built on Felucca 1.5.
minitone.author: S. Schmitz

mutabledreams.author: Kid Bunka
mutabledreams.what: Six synth tracks, or a Lo-Fi sample kit plus three synths, with Plaits, Rings and Elements voices inspired by Mutable Instruments. 156 factory Biomes and 352 tone presets, per-track LFOs, granular effects, 32-step sequences, chord journeys and User Banks.

niagaradrift.author: E. Yerburgh
niagaradrift.what: Two drones that breathe and drift on their own, after the Lyra-8, Subharmonicon and DS-2: twelve presets on the white keys, gestures and scenes to move them, an LFO, delay and a reverb that freezes. Press PLAY to fade them in.

obervave.what: An 8-voice analog-style poly in the spirit of the classic American polys of 1979-84, now on four tracks: each its own sound, arp and sequence; a mixer with chorus, delay, plate reverb and drive sends, a master with DJ filter and compressor. Tracks start on the bar, patterns keep their sounds.
obervave.author: zvenson

pigeon.what: An old-school hip-hop and house sampler after the SP-404 and the PO-33: two song samples and a 16-pad kit, up to 32 chops a song, a 64-step sequencer, patterns and a song arrangement. Built on Felucca.
pigeon.author: The Shrimp Blimp

purplemonkey.what: A first instrument for toddlers: random key bashing and knob turning are rewarded with dancing animated pets and little musical sequences. Press a key, any key.
purplemonkey.author: Quixotic7

rainbow.what: A music toy for little children: 63 cartoon friends, every key in tune, chords, strumming, songs to follow and an ear game, notes on a staff, a volume cap for small ears.
rainbow.author: J. Bartlett

s1vave.what: A synth after the Roland S-1 and the SH-101: a punchy sub-oscillator, a resonant filter, bass and lead sounds and hands-on controls for playing live. Built on OberVave.
s1vave.author: Andrew GG

skiff.what: Six tracks of synths and drums with a groovebox's workflow: fourteen engines, a 64-step sequencer with chords, ratchets, trig conditions and locks, songs, PERFORM with scenes, six themes and a browser editor; FM6 sounds built from scratch on the unit. Built on Felucca, with most of Felucca 1.6.1's work brought over (the second core, MIDI LEARN, INSERT); Felucca's sounds and projects load. Also runs on the SMK-37 Pro. Coming from 1.x: 2.0 saves in new formats – update on Skiff's own page (it backs up and converts), or back up in its editor first.
skiff.author: illuminus5

sloop.what: A live groovebox: tracks, layers, a step sequencer, song mode, punch-in effects and samples, played on the FM-1 in real time.
sloop.author: isod89

speak37.what: The talking synth, its FM-1 build: every key speaks the next word of a sentence at its pitch and chords speak in harmony; nine voices, 20 banks of sentences and songs, RHYTHM with an 808.
speak37.author: M. Geisler

tonitor.what: Six tracks for live ambient and experimental music: three synth engines, patches generated by algorithm, free-length loops with up to ten overdubs each, a granulator, filters and a lush reverb.
tonitor.author: N. Zimas

x0x.what: A groovebox: 909 and 808 drums, two 303s with TB-3PO, a breakbeat generator and song mode.
x0x.author: C. Vestal

zen1.author: aceyprime
zen1.what: Ambient as a living window: cherry petals on a river, koi in a pond, fireflies under a real moon, and every movement a note. Set it down and let it play; the keys play along, the knobs shape the scene.
